OpenCode Dock

Load up like a magazine! Fire!

Real-time Sub-Agent Monitoring · TUI Dock Visualization
Adaptive Theme Colors · Low-Saturation Design Language · EN/ZH Bilingual · Data Persistence

If you find this plugin useful, consider giving it a star ⭐ — thank you!

[![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Repository-black?style=flat-square&logo=github)](https://github.com/LZHcode1986/opencode-subagent-control) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/LZHcode1986/opencode-subagent-control?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/LZHcode1986/opencode-subagent-control/stargazers) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) [![中文](https://img.shields.io/badge/中文-README-blue?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/LZHcode1986/opencode-subagent-control/blob/master/README.md) ![NPM Version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@haisto/opencode-dock?style=flat-square)
--- > This project extends [Hotakus/opencode-subagent-magazine](https://github.com/Hotakus/opencode-subagent-magazine) with real sub-agent cancellation support. > **Compatibility**: from v2.0.0 this plugin requires OpenCode v2.2.5 or newer (`@opencode/plugin` 2.x). The v1 `tui.jsonc` plugin channel and the v1 module shape are gone; reconfigure per section 3 after upgrading. --- Interested in token cache visualization? Check out [opencode-visual-cache](https://github.com/Hotakus/opencode-visual-cache)! --- ## 1. Screenshots
Expanded · Detailed Info 👇
--- ## 2. Features - **Dock Tabs**: Projects / Sessions / Timeline / SubAgent in one row; hover highlights with an underline, the active tab is bold with a brighter rule segment, and the dock scrolls horizontally with left/right arrows when the tabs overflow, and holding an arrow scrolls continuously. Projects lists projects with the current one highlighted and scrolls with the wheel and paging hints when it exceeds the visible rows; clicking a project opens a running session first, then the most recently updated session, and only falls back to the project home when it has no sessions. Sessions / Timeline reuse the same wheel scrolling and `↑/↓ more` paging hints; SubAgent remains fully functional - **User Message Timeline**: User messages grouped by date with the newest at the top, showing 10 rows by default (visible rows controlled by `maxEntries`); click any node to jump to it, with incremental message-event merging and a 20-second polling fallback - **Session List**: Root sessions of the current project sorted by last update; click to switch, running sessions show a braille spinner, and the current session is highlighted - **Real-time Status**: Running (breathing animation), done, error — color-coded dots at a glance - **Token & Cost Tracking**: Per-sub-agent token consumption and cost summary, displayed globally at the top of the panel - **Expandable Details**: Click to expand and view agent type, status, elapsed time, tokens, cost, model, and todo progress, with right-aligned values - **One-click Session Jump**: `→ Open session` link in expanded view to navigate to the sub-agent's full conversation - **One-click Session ID Copy**: Expanded detail shows the sub-agent session ID; click `ses_xxx… ⎘` to copy directly to the system clipboard (Windows/macOS/Linux) - **Manual Dismiss**: `- Dismiss display` button on the right side of expanded view to manually clear stuck/zombie entries (local UI only, does NOT cancel the real task) - **Real Cancel**: Running entries with a session ID show a red `Cancel task` button that calls OpenCode's real cancel API, unblocks the parent task, and shows `cancelled` status - **Status Field**: `status: running/done/error` in expanded view, color-coded to match the status dot - **Scroll to Newest**: `↑ Top` / `↓ Bottom` button jumps to the newest entries; direction adapts to sort order - **Configurable Sort Order**: `options.sortOrder` selects descending (newest first) or ascending (oldest first) - **Scroll Mode**: `options.scrollMode` selects wheel scroll or click-to-scroll (click `↑ more` / `↓ more` to page), resolving dock/global scroll conflicts - **Data window**: Projects / Sessions / Timeline / SubAgent load the most recent 7 days by default; adjust with `dataDays` or `tabs..dataDays`. Running sub-agents are always kept, and timeline pagination stops once it crosses the window - **TTL Auto Cleanup**: Existing retention budget is honored, auto-refreshed on access, expired data purged automatically - **Language Support**: `options.lang` selects Chinese or English and is restored from config --- ## 3. Installation ### 3.1 Method 1: OpenCode Command Install (Recommended) Press **`Ctrl + P`** in OpenCode to open the command palette, search for **`install plugin`**, and enter: ``` @haisto/opencode-dock@latest ``` Press Enter to complete installation and configuration. ### 3.2 Method 2: Manual Install **1. Install the plugin** ```bash npm install -g @haisto/opencode-dock@latest ``` **2. Configure the TUI plugin** ```bash # Option A: run the installer (recommended; writes ~/.config/opencode/cli.json) npx @haisto/opencode-dock ``` ```jsonc # Option B: manually create or edit ~/.config/opencode/cli.json (global config) { "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/v2/cli.json", "plugins": ["@haisto/opencode-dock@latest"] } ``` > **Note**: OpenCode v2 loads TUI plugins from the `plugins` array in `cli.json`; the v1 `tui.jsonc` / `plugin` key is no longer read. Entries may be a bare package string or `{ "package": "...", "options": {} }`. `options` supports these initial settings: ```jsonc { "plugins": [ { "package": "@haisto/opencode-dock@latest", "options": { "enabled": true, "lang": "en", "maxEntries": 10, "dataDays": 7, "sortOrder": "desc", "scrollMode": "wheel", "tabs": { "projects": { "enabled": true }, "sessions": { "maxEntries": 10, "dataDays": 14 }, "timeline": { "enabled": true, "dataDays": 30 }, "subagents": { "maxEntries": 10 } } } } ] } ``` | Key | Type | Description | |-----|------|-------------| | `enabled` | boolean | `false` skips Dock registration; enabled by default | | `lang` | `"zh"` / `"en"` | Initial language; system detection by default | | `maxEntries` | number | Max visible items for every list. Defaults to 10; range 1-100. Display only; it does not limit data fetching | | `dataDays` | number | Days of data loaded by every tab. Defaults to 7; range 1-90 | | `sortOrder` | `"asc"` / `"desc"` | Initial sub-agent sort order | | `scrollMode` | `"wheel"` / `"click"` | Initial sub-agent scroll mode | | `tabs.projects.enabled` | boolean | Show the Projects tab | | `tabs.sessions.enabled` | boolean | Show the Sessions tab | | `tabs.timeline.enabled` | boolean | Show the Timeline tab | | `tabs.subagents.enabled` | boolean | Show the SubAgent tab | | `tabs.projects.maxEntries` / `tabs.sessions.maxEntries` / `tabs.timeline.maxEntries` | number | Per-tab override of global `maxEntries` | | `tabs..dataDays` | number | Per-tab override of global `dataDays` | | `tabs.subagents.maxEntries` / `sortOrder` / `scrollMode` | — | Per-tab override of the global sub-agent settings | > Tabs omitted from `tabs` are shown and inherit the global values. If all four are `false`, the Dock is not registered. ### 3.3 Restart OpenCode Open any session — the OpenCode Dock panel will appear. --- ## 4. Usage Guide ### 4.1 Runtime Settings Configuration lives in `opencode.json` under `options`; the plugin no longer registers slash commands. Restart OpenCode after changing it. ### 4.2 Keyboard & Mouse | Action | Description | |--------|-------------| | Click entry row | Expand / Collapse details | | Scroll / Click `↑ more` `↓ more` | Page through entries (`options.scrollMode` to toggle mode) | | Click `↑ Top` / `↓ Bottom` | Jump to the newest entries (direction adapts to sort order) | | Click `→ Open session` | Navigate to the sub-agent's session | | Click `ses_xxx… ⎘` | One-click copy Session ID to system clipboard (Windows/macOS/Linux/SSH) | | Click `- Dismiss display` | Clear the entry from the plugin display only, does NOT cancel the real task (only shown for running entries) | | Click `Cancel task` (red) | Really cancel the sub-agent via session.abort, unblocks parent task (requires a session ID) | ### 4.3 Status Colors | Color | Meaning | |-------|---------| | 🟢 Green | Done | | 🟡 Yellow (breathing) | Running | | 🔴 Red | Error | | ⚪ Gray | Cancelled | --- ## 5. Updating Due to [OpenCode issue #6774](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/issues/6774), the plugin cache locks to the version at first install and won't auto-detect newer versions on npm. Update steps: **1. Clear the OpenCode plugin cache** ```powershell # Windows Remove-Item -Recurse -Force "$env:USERPROFILE\.cache\opencode\npm\@haisto\opencode-dock@latest" ``` ```bash # macOS / Linux rm -rf ~/.cache/opencode/npm/@haisto/opencode-dock@latest ``` **2. Reinstall the plugin** In OpenCode, press **`Ctrl + P`** → `install plugin` → `@haisto/opencode-dock@latest` → Enter **3. Restart OpenCode** --- ## 6. Language Settings ### 6.1 Config Switching (Recommended) Set `options.lang` to `"zh"` or `"en"` in `opencode.json`; it applies after restart. ### 6.2 Auto Detection When `lang` is omitted, the plugin auto-detects the system language. --- ## 7. Compatibility The plugin is fully model-agnostic and works with all OpenCode-compatible AI models (DeepSeek / Claude / GPT, etc.). Token data and sub-agent information are obtained through the OpenCode SDK standard interfaces. --- ## 8. License MIT

[![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Repository-black?style=flat-square&logo=github)](https://github.com/LZHcode1986/opencode-subagent-control) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/LZHcode1986/opencode-subagent-control?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/LZHcode1986/opencode-subagent-control/stargazers) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) [![English](https://img.shields.io/badge/English-README-blue?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/LZHcode1986/opencode-subagent-control/blob/master/README_EN.md) ![NPM Version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@haisto/opencode-dock?style=flat-square)
--- > 本项目基于 [Hotakus/opencode-subagent-magazine](https://github.com/Hotakus/opencode-subagent-magazine) 扩展，在原版基础上增加了真实取消子代理的能力。 > **兼容性**：v2.0.0 起仅支持 OpenCode v2.2.5 及以上（`@opencode/plugin` 2.x）。v1 的 `tui.jsonc` 插件通道与 v1 模块形态已移除，升级后需按第 3 节重新配置。 --- 对 Token 缓存可视化感兴趣吗？可以试试 [opencode-visual-cache](https://github.com/Hotakus/opencode-visual-cache) 这个插件！ --- ## 1. 图片展示
展开态 · 详细信息👇
--- ## 2. 功能 - **Dock 分页**：Projects / Sessions / Timeline / SubAgent 四个标签同排展示，悬停提亮并加下划线，激活项加粗且下方标尺段变亮；窄屏可横向滚动，内容超出时用左右箭头翻动标签，长按箭头可连续滚动。Projects 展示项目列表，当前项目绿色标记，超出可视行数时可用滚轮和翻页提示滚动；点击项目优先打开正在运行的会话，其次打开最近更新的会话，项目没有会话时才切换到项目首页；Sessions / Timeline 也复用同一套滚轮与 `↑/↓ more` 翻页提示；SubAgent 为完整面板 - **用户消息时间线**：按日期分组展示当前会话的用户消息，最新消息排在最上面，默认显示 10 行（可视行数由 `maxEntries` 控制）；点击任意节点跳转定位，消息事件增量合并并带 20 秒轮询兜底 - **会话列表**：当前项目的根会话按更新时间倒序展示，点击即可切换；运行中的会话显示 braille 动画，当前会话高亮 - **实时状态**：运行中（呼吸动画）、已完成、错误，彩色圆点一目了然 - **Token & 费用追踪**：每个子代理的 Token 消耗和费用汇总，面板顶部全局显示 - **展开详情**：点击展开查看 agent 类型、状态、耗时、Token、费用、模型、进度，字段值右对齐 - **一键进入会话**：展开后点 `→ 进入会话` 跳转子代理的完整对话 - **会话 ID 一键复制**：展开明细显示子代理 Session ID，点击 `ses_xxx… ⎘` 直接复制到系统剪贴板，支持 Windows/macOS/Linux - **手动标记完成**：展开区右侧 `- 仅清除显示` 可手动终结卡住的僵尸条目（仅修改本地展示，不取消真实任务） - **真实取消**：运行中且有会话 ID 的子代理显示红色 `取消任务` 按钮，调用 OpenCode 真实取消接口，父级解除等待，最终显示 `已取消` - **状态字段显示**：展开区 `状态: 运行中/已完成/错误`，颜色与圆点一致，一目了然 - **滚动回顶/回底**：列表底部 `↑ 回顶` / `↓ 回底` 按钮一键跳转到最新条目位置，方向随排序自适应 - **可配置排序**：通过 `options.sortOrder` 选择「降序（最新在前）」或「升序（最早在前）」 - **翻页模式**：通过 `options.scrollMode` 选择「滚轮翻页」或「点击 more 翻页」，解决 Dock 与全局滚动冲突 - **数据窗口**：Projects / Sessions / Timeline / SubAgent 的历史数据默认只加载最近 7 天，可用 `dataDays` 或 `tabs..dataDays` 调整；运行中的子代理始终保留，时间线分页越过窗口后停止继续拉取 - **TTL 自动清理**：数据保留期限沿用已有预算，每次访问自动续期，过期自动清除 - **语言适配**：通过 `options.lang` 设置中文或英文，偏好会随配置恢复 --- ## 3. 安装 ### 3.1 方式一：OpenCode 命令安装（推荐） 在 OpenCode 中按 **`Ctrl + P`** 打开命令面板，搜索 **`install plugin`**，输入： ``` @haisto/opencode-dock@latest ``` 回车即可完成安装与配置。 ### 3.2 方式二：手动安装 **1. 安装插件** ```bash npm install -g @haisto/opencode-dock@latest ``` **2. 配置 TUI 插件** ```bash # 方式 A：运行安装器（推荐，自动写入 ~/.config/opencode/cli.json） npx @haisto/opencode-dock ``` ```jsonc # 方式 B：手动创建或编辑 ~/.config/opencode/cli.json（全局配置） { "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/v2/cli.json", "plugins": ["@haisto/opencode-dock@latest"] } ``` > **注意**：OpenCode v2 从 `cli.json` 的 `plugins` 数组加载 TUI 插件，v1 的 `tui.jsonc` 与 `plugin` 键已不再读取。条目可以直接写包名字符串，也可以写成 `{ "package": "...", "options": {} }`。 `options` 支持以下初始配置： ```jsonc { "plugins": [ { "package": "@haisto/opencode-dock@latest", "options": { "enabled": true, "lang": "zh", "maxEntries": 10, "dataDays": 7, "sortOrder": "desc", "scrollMode": "wheel", "tabs": { "projects": { "enabled": true }, "sessions": { "maxEntries": 10, "dataDays": 14 }, "timeline": { "enabled": true, "dataDays": 30 }, "subagents": { "maxEntries": 10 } } } } ] } ``` | 键 | 类型 | 说明 | |----|------|------| | `enabled` | boolean | `false` 时不注册 Dock；缺省为启用 | | `lang` | `"zh"` / `"en"` | 初始语言，缺省按系统检测 | | `maxEntries` | number | 所有列表最大展示条目数，默认 10，范围 1-100；只影响显示，不限制数据拉取 | | `dataDays` | number | 所有分页默认加载最近多少天的数据，默认 7，范围 1-90 | | `sortOrder` | `"asc"` / `"desc"` | 子代理面板初始排序 | | `scrollMode` | `"wheel"` / `"click"` | 子代理面板初始滚动方式 | | `tabs.projects.enabled` | boolean | 是否显示 Projects 分页 | | `tabs.sessions.enabled` | boolean | 是否显示 Sessions 分页 | | `tabs.timeline.enabled` | boolean | 是否显示 Timeline 分页 | | `tabs.subagents.enabled` | boolean | 是否显示 SubAgent 分页 | | `tabs.projects.maxEntries` / `tabs.sessions.maxEntries` / `tabs.timeline.maxEntries` | number | 对应分页覆盖全局 `maxEntries` | | `tabs..dataDays` | number | 对应分页覆盖全局 `dataDays` | | `tabs.subagents.maxEntries` / `sortOrder` / `scrollMode` | — | SubAgent 分页覆盖全局参数 | > `tabs` 未配置的分页默认显示并沿用全局参数；四个分页全部设为 `false` 时 Dock 不注册。 ### 3.3 重启 OpenCode 进入任意 session，Dock 即可看到子代理监控面板。 --- ## 4. 使用指南 ### 4.1 运行期设置 配置统一走 `opencode.json` 的 `options`，插件不再注册斜杠命令。修改配置后重启 OpenCode 生效。 ### 4.2 键盘 & 鼠标 | 操作 | 说明 | |------|------| | 点击条目行 | 展开 / 收起详情 | | 滚轮 / 点击 `↑ more` `↓ more` | 翻页查看更多子代理（`options.scrollMode` 切换翻页模式） | | 点击 `↑ 回顶` / `↓ 回底` | 跳转到最新条目位置（方向随排序自适应） | | 点击 `→ 进入会话` | 跳转子代理完整对话 | | 点击 `ses_xxx… ⎘` | 一键复制 Session ID 到系统剪贴板（Windows/macOS/Linux/SSH） | | 点击 `- 仅清除显示` | 仅清除插件展示，不取消真实任务（仅运行中时显示） | | 点击 `取消任务`（红色） | 真实取消子代理，调用 session.abort，父级解除等待（需有会话 ID） | ### 4.3 状态颜色 | 颜色 | 含义 | |------|------| | 🟢 绿色 | 已完成 | | 🟡 黄色（呼吸动画） | 运行中 | | 🔴 红色 | 错误 | | ⚪ 灰色 | 已取消 | --- ## 5. 更新 由于 [OpenCode 已知问题 #6774](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/issues/6774)，插件缓存会锁死在首次安装时的版本，不会自动检测 npm 上的新版本。 更新步骤： **1. 清除 OpenCode 插件缓存** ```powershell # Windows Remove-Item -Recurse -Force "$env:USERPROFILE\.cache\opencode\npm\@haisto\opencode-dock@latest" ``` ```bash # macOS / Linux rm -rf ~/.cache/opencode/npm/@haisto/opencode-dock@latest ``` **2. 重新安装插件** 在 OpenCode 中按 **`Ctrl + P`** → `install plugin` → `@haisto/opencode-dock@latest` → 回车 **3. 重启 OpenCode** --- ## 6. 语言设置 ### 6.1 配置切换（推荐） 在 `opencode.json` 的 `options.lang` 中填写 `"zh"` 或 `"en"`，重启后生效。 ### 6.2 自动检测 未配置 `lang` 时自动检测系统语言。 --- ## 7. 兼容性 代码完全模型无关，支持所有 OpenCode 兼容的 AI 模型（DeepSeek / Claude / GPT 等）。 Token 数据和子代理信息均通过 OpenCode SDK 标准接口获取。 --- ## 8.
